projectDescription: A SillyTavern extension for AI image generation supporting 18 providers, 44 style presets, LLM-assisted prompting, contextual filters, batch generation, and a full local backend integration for A1111 and ComfyUI.
keyFeatures: 18 image generation backends (cloud and local) plus configurable custom APIs
44 built-in style presets with prefix/suffix wrapping
Three LLM prompt modes: Tags (Danbooru), Natural, and Custom instruction
Two-step chat-scene prompt pipeline for long or dialogue-heavy chats
Contextual Filters: keyword, AND/OR, and LLM-concept match with prompt modification
Batch generation (1–10 images) with sequential seeds and batch viewer
Auto-generation after AI responses with configurable frequency and delay
Inject mode: AI-tagged prompt extraction from chat replies
Named Configurations storing complete provider + prompt + generation setups
A1111 full control (ADetailer, Hires Fix, IP-Adapter, ControlNet)
ComfyUI custom workflow support with placeholder variables and choice discovery
Character overrides and SillyTavern Style prefix inheritance
Server relay plugin for CivitAI and Replicate behind basicAuthMode
Slash commands (/qig, /qig-auto, /qig-cancel) for Quick Replies automation
Gallery (IndexedDB), prompt history, and per-session generation logs
publicApiSurface: /qig command: mode=direct|palette|inject, quiet=true, trailing prompt text
